# Lecture - Evolution of the Solid Planets of Our Solar System - 1

In this mini-lecture, we are going to look at what is inside the terrestrial planets of the solar system and start thinking about how we can probe their interiors. Even for the Earth, this is not an easy problem but that's where we will start.

It is probably helpful if you already had a look through the [Solar System Guidebook](../../slides/Slides-SS-SolidPlanets.html)
